7/2026: Taking some time off for vacation/family time while life hopefully settles down. Hoping to reopen around late August/early September, but may be sooner than that.

Hello! You can call me Twigs! :)

  • Started trading: Sep 1, 2024
  • I try to reply to every email I get, but patience is greatly appreciated. Please send a follow up after a week if I haven't responded by then!
  • Do not contact me to trade without attaching a list. I don't care if it's big or small, if it's on Encora or not, just give me something
Extra Info

for my own peace of mind

  • I prefer smaller scale trades (3-5 videos or equivalent is perfect), but I'm happy to do large ones as well. Don’t be afraid to ask!
  • I love to have a conversation throughout the trade! If nothing else, tell me about your favourite show :)
  • My links will generally stay active for a week unless you tell me you need more time. I’ll remind you when I send them over!
  • Sizes are listed from my Mac, which is why file sizes may be slightly larger
  • Audios are all listed with the amount of tracks I have, as well as non-DVD videos with multiple files (ex: the recording is split between two acts). Without the given indicator, you can assume there is only one file for the performance. Audios will generally still have a "x1" in this case to minimize confusion
